services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to exterior painting, we deliver professional finishes that last and look immaculate.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Complete room transformations including walls, ceilings, skirting boards, and feature walls. We prep surfaces properly and use premium paints for a flawless finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior painting and render work to protect and refresh your home's façade. We handle all weather conditions and use trade-grade coatings for lasting durability.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Expert painting and staining of doors, frames, shutters, and fitted furniture. Precision preparation ensures a professional finish that enhances any room.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging on any surface, including tricky corners and feature walls. Precise measurements and expert technique create seamless, long-lasting results.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Effects
services.desc: Textured effects, Venetian plaster, murals, and bespoke colour matching. Add character and personality to your spaces with techniques most decorators won't attempt.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality painting that minimises disruption and maintains your brand standards. We work flexibly around business hours.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I wanted customers to actually enjoy the decorating process, not dread it.
about_para_1: MWG Painting & Decorating was founded on the principle of delivering meticulous work without the stress. With over 15 years' experience across Southampton and Hampshire, we've built our reputation on turning customer visions into reality—on time, on budget, and with zero compromise on quality. Every project, whether a small bedroom refresh or a full commercial redecoration, receives the same professional attention.
about_para_2: Customers choose us because we listen, communicate clearly throughout the work, and leave your home spotless. We pride ourselves on honest pricing, no hidden costs, and a friendly approach that makes the whole experience straightforward. Many of our clients return to us year after year, and they recommend us to their friends—that's the trust we've earned.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Mark came out, gave us a realistic quote, and then did the whole living room in two days. The prep work was meticulous—you could tell he cares about getting it right. Walls look fantastic, no drips, edges perfectly sharp. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen and hallway redecorated. Mark and his team were professional, friendly, and tidy. They worked around our schedule, covered everything properly, and cleaned up every day. The finish is immaculate. Can't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: Patricia M.

reviews.text: Used MWG to paint our exterior trim and render. They worked in awful weather and didn't cut corners. Four months on and it still looks brand new. Honest bloke, fair pricing, and he turned up when he said he would. That's rare these days.
reviews.author: James C.
